subject: general
question: A and B are sisters. C and D are a married couple. D is the father of B and brother of E. E is the paternal uncle of A. How is E related to C?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/aecbe9ab6b7da7cca1ac2d356e84b8c992ce57c8b50affd73dfdd3dad30ceb2e.png] 

Given: 

1) A and B are sisters.

2) D is the father of B and brother of E.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/b3ba064247d8bd16c1d1e9979ec4874559389a181d2b06b353f1c62f5654f524.png] 

3) C and D are a married couple.

4) E is the paternal uncle of A.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e3816caa48c02d3a477711a78484beb426d868b1b1cfa815ad600206d539d7aa.png] [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/012a3ac4c3f31ca6fed4e4d08514483d775d18630672c79c6a2bedbe028381b1.png] 

Thus, E is C's brother-in-law or husband's brother.

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 4".
